claim: At load, the PVCAM adapter describes Kinetix_red as BitDepth 16, PixelType 16bit, ReadoutRate '100MHz 16bit' and Binning 1x1. These are the adapter's self-descriptions and not a measurement of the camera's bit depth.
validity_conditions: Read back in a preparatory run -- the first real acquisition on this computer, with no plan, the person having placed the 20x and moved the microscope by hand, software moving nothing. A device's report of itself may enter citing such a run (11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b), graded as an observation by this system: E1 from `measured:`. Not a value of any registered observable. IT DISAGREES WITH pixeltype_misreports_bit_depth, the prior project's record that PixelType reported 12bit while the data were 16-bit: here PixelType reports 16bit. Kept side by side and not reconciled (rule 7). The readout mode, adapter version or camera settings may differ between the two, and neither record is a measurement of bit depth -- which remains a gap here, because no frame today saturated. Slot: A1 and the acquisition wrapper, which must not take a bit depth from either property.
